beats.summary: The movie's plot centers on Michael Scarn, a secret agent, and his enemy Goldenface threatening the NHL All Star Game.

evidence.snippet: Narrator (Stanley's voice as the screen shows Scarn Manor): Michael Scarn, well that's an interesting story.

beats.summary: Michael Scarn trains to play hockey to infiltrate the All Star Game and confront Goldenface.

evidence.snippet: Narrator: Well, Michael Scarn was quickly becoming one of the hottest hockey players in the country.

beats.summary: Michael Scarn races Goldenface in speed skating while being shot at, but Goldenface tries to slow him down rather than kill him.

evidence.snippet: Goldenface: I wasn't trying to kill you, I was trying to slow you down.
